sports.title: Sports at Lawrence
body: We believe in nurturing not only academic excellence, but also sporting spirit. With dedicated coaches, regular training sessions, and participation in inter-school tournaments, our students learn discipline, teamwork, resilience and the value of hard work. Sports help students build strength, agility and coordination in both team and individual formats.
The games played are football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, skating, throwball, kabaddi, taekwondo and kho-kho.

items.title: Dance & Music
items.body: Rhythm meets expression through dance and music. Students develop confidence, coordination and creativity while discovering their voice, movement and joy of performance.

items.title: Drama & Storytelling
items.body: Stories come alive through drama and storytelling. Students build confidence, communication and empathy while learning to express ideas, emotions and imagination with clarity.

items.title: Art & Design
items.body: Art gives imagination a form. Through drawing, painting, craft and design, students explore colour, form and creativity while developing observation, visual thinking and a strong sense of expression.

items.title: Pottery & Creative Making
items.body: Creating with their hands, students turn ideas into tangible forms. Pottery and hands-on making nurture patience, focus, fine-motor skills and the confidence to experiment and create.

items.title: Model United Nations (MUN)
items.body: An academic simulation for Grades 4 to 10. Students research global issues, debate and draft resolutions, building confidence and becoming aware and articulate public speakers.

items.title: Assembly
items.body: Our morning assemblies are vibrant, theme-based sessions that ignite curiosity, promote awareness and communication, and give students the opportunity to speak on stage.

items.title: Show & Tell
items.body: A platform for young learners to express ideas, build confidence and enhance communication skills through showcasing their interests and talents.

stem.title: STEM – Technology Training
stem.lede: Coding and Robotics at Lawrence High School
stem.kicker: Empowering Young Minds with Future-Ready Skills.
stem.body: We nurture innovation through a structured Coding and Robotics curriculum from Grades 1 to 10. Aligned with NEP 2020 and ICSE standards, our programme helps students move from curiosity to real-world programming, design and problem-solving.

steps.text: Introduction to programming using block-based tools, computational thinking and logic.
Visual Python programming using Edublocks, introducing syntax, variables and simple algorithms.
Transition to text-based coding with Python — exploring loops, conditionals and functions.
Hands-on coding with real-world applications and problem-solving.
Building curiosity using sensors and motors with LEGO WeDo and SPIKE Essential.
Building robots using sensors and motors, and applying classroom logic to movement.
Robotics-based simulations using Tinkercad — introducing electronics, circuits and basic AI.
Electronics with ESP32 — Robotics and AI, including sensors, gesture control, Bluetooth and IoT projects, coupled with Python.

programmes.title: Vedic Maths
programmes.body: Our Vedic Maths programme helps students develop strong numerical ability, improve mental calculation skills and build confidence in problem solving. Using ancient Indian techniques, we make mathematics simple, fun and effective for everyday use.
programmes.imageAlt: A student practising Vedic Maths at Lawrence High School

programmes.title: Financial Literacy at Lawrence High School
programmes.body: We empower students with essential Financial Literacy skills from Grades 6 to 8. Aligned with NEP 2020 and ICSE standards, our curriculum covers budgeting, saving, banking and digital payments and many more. Interactive lessons and industrial visits help students connect classroom learning with real-life financial decision-making.
programmes.imageAlt: Students learning financial literacy together at Lawrence High School

trips.title: Field Trips & Fun Trips
trips.body: Our field trips and fun trips provide real-world learning experiences, spark curiosity and create lifelong memories. Visits to museums, industries, historical places and nature destinations help students connect classroom learning with the world around them.
